notes.title: Cozy Organizer v1.1.0 - First Patch!
notes.content:
Hey Cozy Organizers!

Thank you for playing our game, we have been reading your feedback and we want to send out our first patch fixing some issues and implementing some requested feedback.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Memory card game had a bug that we fixed it with this update, additionally various scenes had some colliders we revised. We are listening on your feedback on our Discord and Steam Forums for further issues and will send out fixes for them <3

Changing the Scene After Completion

Many players requested being able to change play around with the item positions on the scenes after they complete a scene. We implemented this and you can keep changing things before taking a photo of your scene!

[h2]Thank you[/h2]

We have been reading the reviews and your comments on Discord and are glad to see so many players passionate about the game. We have passed 100 reviews. If you haven't already, share your thoughts as a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3415240/Cozy_Organizer/]review on the Steam Page[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3415240/Cozy_Organizer/

notes.title: Cozy Organizer v0.7.0 - Demo Update with new Scenes!
notes.content:
Hey Cozy Organizers,

We have a new demo patch live right now, which adds 4 new scenes to the game. We hope you continue giving your feedback using the form at the end of the game and Steam Forums. 

We will continue checking them out periodically and implementing new changes to our game to make it better and even more Cozy!

Check out our newest trailer!
